prompt: Local Docker coding-agent smoke test for slime. No source change is required; inspect the repository and run the local file-check command.
label: slime-local-docker-smoke

metadata.problem_statement: This is a local Docker smoke test for the coding-agent RL loop. No source change is required. Inspect the repository briefly, run `python -c "from pathlib import Path; assert Path('slime/agent/harness/local_script.py').is_file(); print('OK')"`, and finish with a one-line summary.
metadata.eval_cmd: python -c "from pathlib import Path; assert Path('slime/agent/harness/local_script.py').is_file(); print('OK')"
